name: Kit

intro.text: {player}! Pier Head, golden hour, and the ferry horn is hitting perfectly. This is my best backdrop yet.
Chat's been saying I should 'let the Enclosure sponsor a battle'. I said I'd do it for free. For now.
Don't make a face. It's going in the highlights!

win: Hang on, I wasn't even ready! Okay, I was a bit ready.
after: Fine. You're better than the algorithm. Don't tell the algorithm.
